dedupe_keys.name: energiforetagen sverige district heating statistics deliveries prices supplied energy environmental values and district cooling

description: Energiföretagen Sverige collects statistics every year on district heating, district heating prices, combined heat and power and district cooling from all its member companies, which it states account for about 98 percent of district heating deliveries in Sweden, where district heating has more than half of the market for homes and premises. The statistics pages answer questions such as the price of district heating in each municipality, the fuels and energy supplied to produce heat and power in each municipality, how much district heating and district cooling were delivered, with yearly delivery series and local deliveries (sources Statistics Sweden and Energiföretagen), and the environmental values of each local district heating network for resource use, climate impact and share of fossil fuels, published on 18 June 2026 for the past year and a few earlier years. Data are collected through two database applications, the quality key and the damage key, with reporting from January to March. Coverage is Sweden by municipality and network. The statistics are free to view online as web charts and tables; no data licence is stated. Caveats: data come from member company reports, and the damage key is described only as a reporting application. Simulation uses are local heat demand, supply mix and price inputs for district heating planning and decarbonisation studies. Related records: data-ei-sweden-district-heating-technical-data gives the regulator's technical data.
